text.tspan: Filled marker: confirmatory model in the tested family. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only. Blue ticks: detectable gap after Holm (m
= 8). 'Not estimable': every run in that cell gave the same result, so no gap or interval exists (not a zero gap).
Every gap is focal group minus comparison group: a negative gap means the focal group paid less. Rows marked pending have no scored runs yet.
Not estimable: Gemini H1 price Black vs White: 2 tasks, no spread between names; Gemini H2 price women vs men: 2 tasks, no spread between names;
Gemini H3 stated need overridden: 3 tasks, no spread between names; Gemini H4 need guessed from the name: 1 task, every run had the same
outcome; Gemini Asked first (vague) exploratory: 2 tasks, no spread between names.
